# Tencent Cloud
> Tencent Cloud provides cloud infrastructure, AI, databases, networking, security, and developer services for global applications.

Tencent Cloud’s documentation on myqcloud.com covers product overviews, getting started guides, API references, SDKs, best practices, and troubleshooting across compute, storage, networking, databases, security, media, and AI services.

## Documentation Home
- [Documentation Center](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document): Central hub for Tencent Cloud product documentation and guides.
- [API Center](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/api): API reference index for Tencent Cloud services.
- [Product Documentation](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product): Browse documentation by product and service category.
- [Developer Resources](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/developer): Developer-focused resources, tools, and integration materials.
- [FAQ Center](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/faq): Frequently asked questions across Tencent Cloud products and services.

## Compute
- [Cloud Virtual Machine](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/213): Documentation for provisioning and managing CVM instances.
- [Auto Scaling](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/377): Guides for scaling compute capacity automatically.
- [Batch Compute](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/599): Documentation for large-scale batch job execution.
- [Bare Metal Cloud](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/386): Guides for dedicated physical server deployment and management.
- [GPU Cloud Computing](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/560): Documentation for GPU-accelerated compute workloads.
- [Tencent Kubernetes Engine](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/457): Managed Kubernetes cluster deployment and operations.
- [Serverless Cloud Function](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/583): Event-driven serverless function development and management.

## Storage and CDN
- [Cloud Object Storage](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/436): Object storage service documentation, APIs, and usage guides.
- [Cloud Block Storage](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/362): Persistent block storage management for compute instances.
- [File Storage](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/582): Shared file storage service documentation and operations.
- [Content Delivery Network](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/228): CDN acceleration configuration, caching, and delivery guides.
- [Data Transfer Hub](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1081): Documentation for secure data transfer and migration workflows.

## Networking
- [Virtual Private Cloud](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/215): Network isolation, subnets, routing, and connectivity documentation.
- [Cloud Load Balancer](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/214): Load balancing setup, listeners, and traffic distribution guides.
- [Direct Connect](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/216): Dedicated network connection documentation for hybrid environments.
- [NAT Gateway](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1015): Outbound internet access and address translation configuration.
- [VPN Connection](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1037): Site-to-site and remote access VPN setup guides.
- [Private Link](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1031): Private service access within Tencent Cloud networks.

## Databases and Data
- [TencentDB for MySQL](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/236): Managed MySQL database deployment, operations, and tuning.
- [TencentDB for PostgreSQL](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/409): PostgreSQL service documentation and administration guides.
- [TencentDB for Redis](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/239): Managed Redis caching and in-memory database documentation.
- [TencentDB for MongoDB](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/240): MongoDB cluster management, backup, and scaling guides.
- [TDSQL-C for MySQL](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1098): Cloud-native MySQL-compatible database documentation.
- [Data Lake Compute](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1155): Serverless analytics and SQL query documentation.

## Security
- [Cloud Firewall](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1130): Network security policy management and traffic protection guides.
- [Web Application Firewall](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/627): Web attack protection, rules, and deployment documentation.
- [Anti-DDoS Advanced](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1029): DDoS mitigation service configuration and operations.
- [SSL Certificate Service](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/400): Certificate issuance, deployment, and lifecycle management.
- [Cloud Access Management](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/598): Identity, roles, policies, and access control documentation.
- [Key Management Service](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1030): Encryption key creation, storage, and usage guides.

## AI and Media
- [Tencent Cloud AI](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/301): AI service documentation and model capability references.
- [Machine Translation](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/551): Translation API usage, parameters, and integration guides.
- [Speech Recognition](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1093): Automatic speech recognition service documentation.
- [Text To Speech](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1073): Speech synthesis API documentation and examples.
- [Video on Demand](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/266): Media upload, processing, playback, and management guides.
- [Media Processing Service](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/862): Video transcoding, editing, and workflow documentation.
- [Instant Messaging](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1047): Messaging SDKs, APIs, and integration documentation.

## API and SDK
- [API 3.0 Overview](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/api/1270/72248): Overview of Tencent Cloud API request signing and usage.
- [API Explorer](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1278): Interactive API debugging and request generation tools.
- [SDK Center](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/sdk): Official SDK documentation and language support index.
- [Tencent Cloud SDK for Python](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/sdk/1013): Python SDK installation, authentication, and usage guidance.
- [Tencent Cloud SDK for Java](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/sdk/1012): Java SDK integration and API invocation examples.
- [Tencent Cloud SDK for Go](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/sdk/1014): Go SDK setup and service client usage.
- [Tencent Cloud SDK for Node.js](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/sdk/1011): Node.js SDK documentation and sample code.

## Best Practices and Tutorials
- [Getting Started](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/getting-started): Introductory guides for new Tencent Cloud users.
- [Best Practices](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/best-practice): Recommended architectures and operational guidance.
- [Troubleshooting](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/troubleshooting): Diagnostic and issue resolution resources across products.
- [Use Cases](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/use-cases): Solution-oriented examples for common cloud scenarios.
- [Tutorials](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/tutorial): Step-by-step implementation guides for Tencent Cloud services.

## Support and Account
- [Billing Documentation](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/555): Billing, pricing models, and payment-related documentation.
- [Account Information](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/378): Account management, verification, and security settings.
- [Message Center](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/656): Notification and message management documentation.
- [Service Level Agreement](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/3015): SLA documentation for Tencent Cloud services.
- [Contact Support](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/253): Support channels, ticketing, and service assistance guidance.
